patch.1.0.5:
• 6 garden landmarks: build one in the middle of each area with stars and grow it with coins. New look every 10 levels
• Decorations rearranged and fewer friends crowding the garden
• Share & invite: invited friends get 50 diamonds, you get 100
• Decor set bonuses and decor score
• "Max" button and x2 goal bars in upgrades
• New-version alerts and in-game updates
• Mailbox: notice details, select & delete, old read letters tidy up
• New friends screen: suggested friends, 3 gifts and 3 adds a day
• Fixed missing sound, sharing, sign-in, request limits and more

Here is some energy as an update gift!

patch.1.0.6:
• Added error reports so we can fix problems faster (no account info is sent)
• Changing the phone's clock no longer makes game time go backward
• Players you reported no longer appear in suggested friends
• Request bubbles now stay right above each friend
• Landmarks pop in when you switch areas
• New-version alerts no longer get missed

patch.1.0.7:
• When tea or stardust opens, it now starts from level 1 (items you already have change to the level of the same value)
• When the board is full with nothing to merge, we point out the item that's least costly to sell
• Friends sometimes ask for lower-level items too
• Fixed purchased gems sometimes not arriving
• Older progress on another device no longer overwrites newer progress
• Logging out as a guest keeps your progress on this device (start as guest again to continue)
• Friends see your game nickname instead of your account name
• Visitor and bubble rewards still arrive if they leave while an ad plays
• Game sounds now play alongside YouTube or music instead of stopping them
• The 2x first-purchase diamond bonus now applies once across all packs
• Many other fixes
